title: Polar-stratospheric precursors, NAM and major SSW modulation
nam_primary_proxy: negative standardized area-weighted polar-cap geopotential-height anomaly north of 65N

ssw_definition.central_date: first daily-mean zonal-mean u at 60N, 10 hPa reversal from westerly to easterly in November-March
ssw_definition.between_events: 20 consecutive westerly days required between accepted central dates
ssw_definition.final_warming_exclusion: at least 10 consecutive westerly days must return before 30 April

persistent_minus_short_robustness: BH-FDR q<0.05, 95% winter-block bootstrap CI excludes zero, and leave-one-winter-out sign stability >=0.90
interpretation: continuous vortex/NAM measures are primary; major SSW analyses are secondary because of small sample size
